messages:
Nora Lee: Quick sync  launch campaign plan needs final tweaks: search ramp, retarget windows, creative rotation, and geo-burst buffer.
Miguel Santos: I'll run search. Proposal: 3-day ramp (Mon 40%, Tue 80%, Wed 120% peak 9-11am PT) then taper Thu 50%. Set daily caps.
Priya Patel: Landing page note: append utm_campaign=launch_q2 and ensure webinar_reg event fires. Adding hidden field for creative variant.
Samir Ahmed: Retargeting: windows 0-3d (high freq), 4-10d (mid), 11-30d (low). Frequency caps 3/day, 2/day, 1/day. Dedicated segment for pricing page viewers who didn't register.
Elaine Cho: Creative checklist: 2 hero images, 3 headlines, 1 15s demo. I'll label assets LW24_A/B_Image1 etc. Rotate creative every 48 hours; swap hero at Wed 7am PT before webinar.
Nora Lee: Buffer ask  can we reserve 10% budget for high-performing geos?
Miguel Santos: yes. I'll create a geo-burst budget that only triggers if ROAS threshold met. Rule: enable at 6am Wed if ROAS > target and impressions > 1k.
Priya Patel: Routing: webinar registrants -> SFDC campaign Launch_Q2_Webinar. Auto-assign leads to "launch-wave" queue. Mark lead as "engaged" if attended or watched >50%.
Samir Ahmed: Exclude attendees and recent trial signups (30d) from retargeting. Also boost retarget bids +15% for users who opened the webinar email within 48h.
Miguel Santos: Adding automated rule: pause non-brand if CPA > 2x baseline. Also scale brand bids down Thu morning.
AdOps Bot: Campaigns provisioned: search_brand_87990, search_nonbrand_87991, retarg_0_3_87992, retarg_4_10_87993, retarg_11_30_87994.
Elaine Cho: QA: GA4 events webinar_reg and webinar_attend wired and tested on staging.
Nora Lee: Great. Drop a one-line update by EOD Friday and I'll assemble the launch playbook. :rocket:
